reason: My tourists already pay by card at the table, and the reviews that bring them in are on Tripadvisor and Google, not in a new Tbilisi app nobody abroad has heard of. My regulars already come three or four times a week, so I don't need a loyalty tool to bring them back.
objection: Foreign guests won't bother scanning a QR to pay when the waiter is standing there with a terminal, and I'd be paying an extra transaction fee on top for dish ratings that don't show up where tourists actually look.
would_change_my_mind: If a guest who paid by QR got pushed straight to leave the review on my Google or Tripadvisor page, so it actually raised the ratings tourists see.
